collections.name: Calvin and Hobbes
notes: First collection. Foreword by Garry Trudeau. Filler B&W vignettes.

alterations.19851215: 10th and 11th panels reversed in first edition of Book 1 (1987). Corrected in later editions and Complete.

collections.name: Something Under the Bed Is Drooling
notes: Foreword by Pat Oliphant. May 23, 1987 strip excluded (only in Essential treasury).

collections.name: Yukon Ho!
notes: Includes 'The Yukon Song' original poem.

collections.name: Weirdos From Another Planet!
notes: Excludes Nov 27-30, 1988 (those strips are in The Revenge of the Baby-Sat instead). Aug 28, 1988 Sunday was redrawn for Complete (book 1, p. 478). Source: Weirdos wiki page.

alterations.19880313: Possibly miscolored dinosaur Sunday strip — off-putting greyish-green hue in some book editions. Not Watterson's intention.

collections.name: Scientific Progress Goes "Boink"
notes: Some June/July 1990 strips also in Snow Goons.

alterations.19891224: Vertical/redrawn format. Two versions exist. Original horizontal (red carpet) in newspapers and Complete. Vertical (green floor) in Book 6 and Indispensable treasury. Complete version confirmed via personal scan of the 2005 hardcover.

collections.name: Attack of the Deranged Mutant Killer Monster Snow Goons
notes: Sunday strips B&W; not in colour until Complete.

collections.name: The Days Are Just Packed
notes: Excludes sabbatical repeats May 5, 1991 to Feb 1, 1992.

collections.name: There's Treasure Everywhere
notes: Excludes sabbatical repeats Apr 3 to Dec 31, 1994. June 3, 1995 strip also in Magical World.

collections.name: It's a Magical World
notes: Final collection. June 3, 1995 strip also in Treasure Everywhere.

collections.name: The Authoritative Calvin and Hobbes
notes: Treasury of Books 3+4. Includes 7-page elephant story. Colour Sundays.

alterations.19880313: Possibly miscolored dinosaur Sunday strip — off-putting greyish-green hue in some book editions. Not Watterson's intention.

collections.name: The Calvin and Hobbes Portable Compendium Set 1
notes: Nearly 500 comics from November 1985 to March 1987. First of seven sets.

collections.name: The Calvin and Hobbes Portable Compendium Set 2
notes: Nearly 500 comics from March 1987 to July 1988. Second of seven sets.

collections.name: The Calvin and Hobbes Portable Compendium Set 3
notes: Nearly 500 comics from June 1988 to November 1989. Third of seven sets.

collections.name: The Calvin and Hobbes Portable Compendium Set 4
notes: Nearly 500 comics from December 1989 to April 1991. Fourth of seven sets.

collections.name: The Calvin and Hobbes Portable Compendium Set 5
notes: Nearly 500 comics from March 1991 to March 1993. Fifth of seven sets.

collections.name: The Calvin and Hobbes Portable Compendium Set 6
notes: Nearly 500 comics from July 1993 to July 1995. Sixth of seven sets.

collections.name: The Calvin and Hobbes Portable Compendium Set 7
notes: Contains the complete final year of strips (1995-1996). Seventh of seven sets.
Includes bonus gallery of standalone stories, poems, and archival art from the treasury editions (Spaceman Spiff, A Nauseous Nocturne).

collections.name: The Complete Calvin and Hobbes
notes: Hardcover: 3 volumes. Contains all strips except Nov 28, 1985 washing machine original. Some strips have altered text.

alterations.19870107: Text changed: 'Was I adopted?' → 'Was I genetically engineered or cloned?' (Reference to adoption removed in Complete. References to cannibalism and child labor in same strip were NOT changed.)
alterations.19871124: Text changed: 'He says it's colder because the Earth's orbit is taking us farther from the sun.' → 'He says it's colder because our hemisphere is tilted away from the sun now.' (Original text had scientifically incorrect explanation of seasons. Complete has corrected science.)
alterations.19881125: Text changed: 'Biological mother' → 'A good mother' (Both mentions of 'biological mother' changed to 'a good mother' in Complete. Omitted reference to biological parentage/adoption.)
alterations.19891224: Vertical/redrawn format. Two versions exist. Original horizontal (red carpet) in newspapers. Vertical (green floor) redrawn version used in Book 6 and Indispensable treasury. Complete version confirmed via personal scan of the 2005 hardcover uses the original horizontal format.

collections.name: The Essential Calvin and Hobbes
notes: Treasury of Books 1+2. Foreword by Charles M. Schulz. Includes 'A Nauseous Nocturne'. Colour Sundays.

collections.name: Exploring Calvin and Hobbes
notes: Exhibition catalogue with interview by Jenny Robb. Unordered.

collections.name: The Indispensable Calvin and Hobbes
notes: Treasury of Books 5+6. Several illustrated poems. Colour Sundays.

alterations.19891224: Vertical/redrawn format. Two versions exist. Original horizontal (red carpet) in newspapers and Complete. Vertical (green floor) in Book 6 and Indispensable treasury. Complete version confirmed via personal scan of the 2005 hardcover.

collections.name: The Calvin and Hobbes Lazy Sunday Book
notes: Sunday strips only. Includes 10-page Spiff story and redrawn Aug 28, 1988. Afterword by Watterson.

collections.name: In the Shadow of the Night
notes: Small-format UK book. Compact selection of strips.

collections.name: Calvin and Hobbes: Sunday Pages 1985–1995
notes: Exhibition catalogue. 36 Sunday strips with original sketches. Unordered.

collections.name: The Calvin and Hobbes Tenth Anniversary Book
notes: Curated selection by Watterson with commentary. Strip list not fully known (unordered).

collections.name: Thereby Hangs a Tale
notes: Small-format UK book. Compact selection of strips.

collections.name: One Day the Wind Will Change
notes: Small-format UK book. Compact selection of strips.
